# Counting completed lessons

A course dashboard records attendance, submitted exercises and time spent in the application. These measures help notice a broken routine or an assignment nobody opened. They are straightforward to collect without judging every answer.

Completion does not measure whether a learner can distinguish similar vowels on an unfamiliar recording. A listening assessment needs its own task and scoring rule. Avoid turning minutes spent into a general proficiency score. Use the dashboard to start a conversation about study habits, not to replace direct evidence.
